history.summary: 1BR at The Continuum, the large freehold new launch in D15 (TOP ~2027), $1.368M at $2,443 PSF — below the $2,801 URA median. Rare freehold scale in East Coast with strong launch demand, but it's an unbuilt new launch (null URA appreciation, new-launch bias) and a niche 1BR, with the nearest MRT a soft 830m away.
history.rating_rationale: The Continuum's freehold land in a leasehold-dominated East Coast is its genuine differentiator, and $2,443 PSF is below the project median (~$2,801), so this is likely a lower-floor stack at a relatively sensible entry. But appreciation is null (no resale history — TOP ~2027), has_new_launch_bias is on, 1BR is the narrowest resale/tenant segment, and 830m to Dakota MRT is mediocre for a city-fringe project. Freehold + D15 deep buyer pool support a hold; the new-launch premium and niche unit cap the upside to Neutral.
red_flags: New launch, TOP ~2027 — no resale price history; developer-inflated pricing
830m to Dakota MRT — soft walkability for the price
catalysts: Rare large freehold development in leasehold-heavy East Coast (D15)
Deep D15 buyer pool and lifestyle demand
